metadata.objective: Auditing open-weight image-to-3D neural generators vs dedicated garment try-on architectures

evaluation_criteria.1_open_boundary_preservation: Garments must maintain open neck, cuff, hem, and waist loops. Solid caps make virtual dressing physically impossible.
evaluation_criteria.2_skeletal_rigging: Meshes must contain ARA 20-bone humanoid vertex weights to animate with avatar locomotion without ballooning or tearing.
evaluation_criteria.3_geometric_clearance: Interior cavity must clear humanoid body dimensions with parameterized ease margin.
evaluation_criteria.4_texture_resolution: Albedo maps must retain high-frequency garment details, weave texture, logos and plackets.
evaluation_criteria.5_device_efficiency: Sub-second inference achievable on client/edge hardware (MPS, WebGL, mobile) without requiring dedicated 24GB CUDA servers.

neural_models_evaluated.architecture: Structured Latent Flow Diffusion + Triplane Sparse Voxels
neural_models_evaluated.uv_parameterization: Implicit NeuS marching cubes UV unwrap (fragmented)
neural_models_evaluated.tryon_suitability_verdict: FAIL (Requires boolean carving to open neck/cuffs; no rigging)
neural_models_evaluated.architectural_notes: State-of-the-art general object geometry from single image, but produces watertight solid meshes without garment interior volume or open wearability boundaries.

neural_models_evaluated.architecture: Two-stage Diffusion (SDF coarse + Multiview high-res synthesis)
neural_models_evaluated.tryon_suitability_verdict: FAIL (Solid interior prevents body penetration; no skeletal weights)
neural_models_evaluated.architectural_notes: High geometric detail, but assumes watertight rigid bodies. Neck and hem cavities are filled with solid geometry.

neural_models_evaluated.architecture: Triplane NeRF + Direct Mesh Extraction via DMC
neural_models_evaluated.uv_parameterization: Atlas chart unwrap with baked lighting
neural_models_evaluated.tryon_suitability_verdict: FAIL (Lightning fast, but solid enclosed mesh; lacks garment sleeve tubes)
neural_models_evaluated.architectural_notes: Exceptionally fast single-feedforward mesh generator. However, mesh extraction produces closed genus-0 hulls unsuitable for avatar dressing.

neural_models_evaluated.architecture: Large Reconstruction Model (LRM) Transformer + NeRF Triplane
neural_models_evaluated.uv_parameterization: Vertex colors converted to UV via marching cubes
neural_models_evaluated.tryon_suitability_verdict: FAIL (Mesh interior is solid; no boundary loops for neck or hem)
neural_models_evaluated.architectural_notes: Fast feed-forward triplane LRM. Great for rigid props and toys, but clothing becomes a solid sculpture.

neural_models_evaluated.architecture: Multiview Diffusion + Large Multi-view Triplane Reconstruction
neural_models_evaluated.tryon_suitability_verdict: FAIL (Solid interior, lacks boundary loops and rigging)
neural_models_evaluated.architectural_notes: Generates 6 synthetic views and reconstructs mesh. Still outputs watertight solid meshes that cannot slip over a 3D avatar.

neural_models_evaluated.architecture: Convolutional U-Net Triplane from Orthographic Multiview
neural_models_evaluated.tryon_suitability_verdict: FAIL (Watertight solid capping, no deformation skinning)
neural_models_evaluated.architectural_notes: Effective orthographic projection mapping, but retains solid volume problem.

neural_models_evaluated.tryon_suitability_verdict: FAIL (High texture sharpness, but solid mesh unwearable)
neural_models_evaluated.architectural_notes: Excellent surface normal detail from multi-view diffusion, but does not understand cloth topology or internal clearance.

neural_models_evaluated.boundary_topology: Gaussian Splat Point Cloud (Not Polygonal Mesh)
neural_models_evaluated.uv_parameterization: Spherical Harmonics per Gaussian (No UV Map)
neural_models_evaluated.tryon_suitability_verdict: FAIL (3DGS representation cannot be rigged with standard skeletal bones in WebGL/Three.js)
neural_models_evaluated.architectural_notes: Impressive novel-view synthesis as Gaussian splats, but cannot be exported as standard GLB polygonal rigged garments for WebGL avatars.

yorvyn_hybrid_architecture.architecture: SegFormer-B2 Clothes Semantic Parsing + Contour-Carved Vertical Slice Profiling + Open-Boundary Topology + Photographic UV Parameterization + ARA 20-Bone Skeletal Rigging
yorvyn_hybrid_architecture.boundary_topology: True Open Boundary Loops (Neckline, Cuffs, Hem, Waistband preserved 100%)
yorvyn_hybrid_architecture.uv_parameterization: Photographic front/rear orthogonal albedo UV shell projection
yorvyn_hybrid_architecture.tryon_suitability_verdict: PASS (Wearable open-boundary shell, 20-bone ARA rigging, 0.00% avatar penetration)
yorvyn_hybrid_architecture.architectural_notes: Specifically architected for virtual try-on: solves the fundamental flaw of open-weight neural models by maintaining true open garment boundary loops, avatar geometric clearance, and real-time skeletal rigging.

selection_verdict.rationale: Every open-weight neural 3D model (TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D, SF3D, TripoSR, InstantMesh, CRM, Unique3D, LGM) produces watertight solid caps or non-rigged representations. YORVYN's hybrid architecture combines the semantic accuracy of deep vision models (SegFormer-B2) with mathematically guaranteed open-boundary topology and 20-bone skeletal skinning.
